svg.title: On real momentum s(p) is the nonnegative squared curl frequency. The scalar massive covariant- site operator at a group field is D∗ UDU + μ2; its normalized inverse is μ2(D∗ UDU + μ2)−1. The auxiliary regulator is μ2 times its ninth power, and the comparison site operator is D∗ UDU plus that regulator. These are ordinary finite positive matrices when μ > 0. Their symbols at the identity are respectively s + μ2, dμ, cμ, s + cμ. The ninth power is part of the construction, not a variable exponent sent to infinity. For link fields, copy the site regulator into each of the four link directions at the link’s initial site. Add it to the physical quadratic Hessian and to DUD∗ U. This defines the positive auxiliary
